text: Dream: thin bright vertical slivers/notches at the left (x~520,y~300-390) and right (x~750,y~380) edges of the black-hole shadow where the disk crosses it; looks like a ray-march seam rather than blur. tick ~210

Dream near end (tick ~1480): the lensed inner ring under the shadow stops abruptly with hard-cut ends at about x=425,y=355 and x=855,y=355 instead of closing or fading; the left edge of the shadow has a jagged bright stair-step sliver (x~410-460, y~250-330). Looks like a ray-march cutoff/seam, not just low-res blur.

Quarters porthole at wake-up (facing yaw -6, porthole 2.7 m ahead): view is almost entirely black with a hard-edged pale grey vertical strip down the left inside of the frame (x~563-585) and a dim brown arc; does not read as the 'ridiculous view' Ines promises, and the strip looks like a gap between the porthole frame and the sky render. Pressing E here did nothing and no use prompt appeared.

Corridor just outside quarters (x=-0.66,z=4.05, yaw 87, room=corridor, tick ~3630): after walking straight out of the quarters door the whole view ahead is open space (stars + galaxy band) with no wall, floor or ceiling; only a lone wall panel on the right and a dark pillar on the left. No window frame. Looks like missing corridor geometry / a hole into the sky render.

Probe console after launch (tick ~6550): the readouts lead with '2.1 M' and '1.22 s for this hole' and 'r_s' with no explanation of what M (geometric mass unit) or r_s mean; as a brand-new player I could not tell what the big numbers measure. Also the pause/menu button (top right) sits on top of the panel's scrollbar and the 'Esc or Q to step back' hint.

Bridge front window, standing at the probe console facing yaw -6 (tick ~7000): same seam as the dream - a bright vertical sliver at the right inner edge of the shadow (x~735,y~380-420) and a hooked bright fragment at the lower-left edge (x~450,y~450). Also the 'Click to look around' pill reappears after Esc from the console and sits right on top of the K-1 probe label (x~640,y~440-470).

Bridge, facing the front window after stepping back from the probe console (tick ~10950): the K-1 label's third line overlaps the 'Click to look around' pill, so both are garbled ('Click to look around' printed over another line of text) at x~560-730,y~468.

Optional objective 4 'study the spacetime map (port wall)' started at tick 12783 and was marked completed at tick 13389 (~10 game s) although I never moved or touched the map console; the objective box vanished while a 'Map 4 m' waypoint still points left. A new player gets no chance to act on it and the leftover marker is confusing.
